items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to the victim's account and private data. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Stored Cross-Site Scripting)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Stored Cross-Site Scripting)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Persistent backdoors injected on Adobe Commerce via new CosmicSting attack
items.summary: Mass-abuse of this critical vulnerability has been observed in the wild, with threat actors injecting malicious scripts into CMS blocks and establishing persistent backdoors.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation.
